summary: Iter150 retest after main-agent's grid-gap fix + ATP transparency rework. All four review-request focus areas PASS. (1) STOK & ATP: /api/inventory/status-board returns row fields total_available/total_reserved/total_incoming/total_atp/total_on_hand/total_hold/total_pending_demand. For every row (20 products): expected ATP = total_available + total_incoming − total_pending_demand MATCHES total_atp (0 mismatches); expected Stok Fisik = total_available + total_reserved + total_hold MATCHES total_on_hand (0 mismatches). UI frontend (?view=inventory-board, admin ent_ksc): data-testid=status-board-formula visible with correct Indonesian formula text ('Rumus: ATP = Tersedia + Incoming (PO dalam horizon) − permintaan tertunda (backorder) · Stok Fisik = Tersedia + Dipesan + tertahan (karantina/QC/blokir/cadangan makloon).'). Row BTK-MEGA-001 shows isb-hold-prod_batik_mega='tertahan 162' and isb-pending-prod_batik_mega='− tertunda 437'; visible numbers 968.03 Stok Fisik = 310 Tersedia + 496.03 Dipesan + 162 tertahan ✓; 673 ATP = 310 + 800 Incoming − 437 tertunda ✓. Metric cards: Total ATP 2.816,79 = sum(by_entity atp) and Total Incoming 1.575 = sum(by_entity incoming); UI uses entity-scoped (by_entity.ent_ksc) not group totals which is the correct per-entity view the user sees. Previous iter149 complaint about transparency is now FULLY RESOLVED. (2) DIV-GRID 12px COLUMN-GAP: CSS rule '#root [class*="grid-cols-["]:not([class*="gap-"]) { column-gap: 12px; }' at components.css:872 is active. Faktur Masukan (?view=input-tax) list header renders as 'Nomor | NSFP/Supplier | Tagihan/PO | DPP | PPN | Periode | Aksi' — PPN and Periode are now visually separated (previously glued 'PPNPERIODE'). Spot-checked 8 other div-grid lists (hr-employees, hr-attendance, suppliers, rfq, contracts, cash-advances, supplier-items, reorder-suggestions): all have computed column-gap=12px on primary grid rows (sub-grids use 8px which is explicit from Tailwind gap-2 utility and intentional), NO horizontal overflow on any screen (scrollWidth=viewportWidth=1920 on all). (3) REGRESSION Kesehatan Konfigurasi: GET /api/config/health → NOT_WIRED=0, STALE_REF=0, BAD_REF=0 (green). Riwayat Perubahan: audit-log /api/audit-logs?limit=500 scan found zero 'TEST_' or 'iter1xx' tagged rows; the lone 'test toggle' entry is a legitimate user-authored reason unrelated to pollution. No 'TEST iter' or 'TEST_' text present anywhere on inventory-board, input-tax, special-orders, returns, suppliers, approval-rules, or rnd-samples pages visited. (4) POP-UP SPOT-CHECK (5/5): opened and visually inspected without submitting: create-special-order-btn (?view=special-orders, 896x847 modal), create-return-btn (?view=returns, 896x426), create-supplier-button (?view=suppliers, 896x1724), approval-rules create-rule-btn (896x462), rnd-sample-create-button (sample-form-modal, 896x1149). All contained within viewport (no cut-off, no overflow right/bottom, no negative top/left). STRICT READ-ONLY observed — no data created, no config values modified, no audit_log rows added.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryStatusBoard metric cards aggregate rows via rows.reduce using pv() (which reads entity-scoped by_entity values). Row columns also show entity-scoped values. API /api/inventory/status-board returns both group totals (total_*) and by_entity[].atp — frontend consistently picks entity view for admin ent_ksc. This is now coherent with the formula note.
config_health.py remains green (263 OK / 2 NOT_USED / 0 stale / 0 bad). Suggest a CI/pytest guard that fails build if NOT_WIRED/STALE_REF/BAD_REF > 0 so this regression cannot sneak back.
